Q1_auth_erros.query: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at)::date as day, payload->>'action' as action, payload->>'error_code' as error_code, count(*) as cnt FROM auth.audit_log_entries WHERE created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' AND (payload->>'error_code') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC LIMIT 30
Q1_auth_erros.nota: Coluna error_code nao existe diretamente — fica em payload JSON. Consulta corrigida retornou 0 linhas: nenhum error_code registrado nos ultimos 7 dias.
Q1_auth_erros.observacao: Ausencia de erros de auth nos logs nao e necessariamente sinal de saude — pode indicar que o nivel de log do Supabase Auth nao persiste error_code no payload. Verificar no Supabase Dashboard > Authentication > Logs.

Q2_cron_falhas.query: SELECT j.jobname, r.start_time::date as day, r.status, LEFT(r.return_message,100) as msg FROM cron.job_run_details r JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid=r.jobid WHERE r.start_time>NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' AND r.status!='succeeded' ORDER BY r.start_time DESC LIMIT 20

detalhes_pico_20261016.query: SELECT j.jobname, count(*) as cnt, LEFT(r.return_message,80) as msg FROM cron.job_run_details r JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid=r.jobid WHERE r.start_time::date='2026-10-16' AND r.status!='succeeded' GROUP BY j.jobname, msg ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

resultado.msg: ERROR: canceling statement due to statement timeout (CONTEXT SQL)

detalhes_pico_20261016.analise: Em 2026-10-16 ocorreu um pico massivo de 1779 falhas de cron — todos os jobs com 'job startup timeout' simultaneamente. Indica indisponibilidade da infra Supabase (connection pool saturado ou edge runtime fora) por varios minutos naquele dia. talkx-scheduler-1min acumulou adicionalmente 31 erros de statement timeout (query excedeu limite de tempo), sugerindo carga excessiva quando o servico voltou.

Q4_wal_backup.query: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('archive_mode','wal_level','max_wal_senders') ORDER BY name
Q4_wal_backup.analise: Configuracao WAL saudavel: archive_mode=on (backup continuo ativo), wal_level=logical (suporta replicacao logica e CDC), max_wal_senders=5 (slots de replicacao disponiveis).

Q5_tabelas_auditoria.query: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND (tablename ILIKE '%audit%' OR tablename ILIKE '%log%' OR tablename ILIKE '%history%' OR tablename ILIKE '%changelog%') ORDER BY tablename
Q5_tabelas_auditoria.analise: 14 tabelas de log/auditoria encontradas. Cobertura ampla: ai_usage_logs, audit_logs, contact_deletion_audit, department_audit_logs, login_attempts, connection_health_logs, talkx_delivery_log.

Q6_pii_sem_retencao.query: SELECT c.table_name, c.column_name FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='public' AND c.column_name IN ('email','phone','nome','name','cpf','rg','address','endereco') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns c2 WHERE c2.table_schema='public' AND c2.table_name=c.table_name AND c2.column_name IN ('deleted_at','anonymized_at','expires_at')) ORDER BY c.table_name LIMIT 30
Q6_pii_sem_retencao.analise: Tabelas de alto risco LGPD sem coluna de retencao: login_attempts (email + ip_address + user_agent), password_reset_requests (email), profiles (name + email + phone). A maioria das ocorrencias de 'name' sao nomes de entidades nao-pessoais (campanhas, flows, etc). Critico: login_attempts armazena email + IP sem TTL ou mecanismo de expiracao identificado via SQL.
